title: Remote-viewed Martian pyramids as hibernation chambers

tellings.quote: these pyramidal places are like hibernation Chambers they're trying to survive until somebody comes to save them

plain: Pyramid-shaped places on Mars are hibernation chambers, where beings are trying to stay alive until someone comes to rescue them. A remote viewer named Joe McMoneagle says this on Jesse Michels's show. Remote viewing is the practice of trying to describe a distant place using only the mind, and McMoneagle says he viewed Mars this way himself. If he is right, Mars once held life that is still waiting there.
